title: Choose the visual world for Club Duel
question: The roll assigned the Venue Draw Sheet. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Sketches show the audience phone, where the score race lives.

options.label: Venue Draw Sheet
options.lineage: the printed draw sheet a director tapes to the venue wall and marks up live
options.thesis: The duel runs like the wall sheet, marked live in two club markers.
materials: printed sheet on a painted wall
options.viewport: Totals band split into Club A blue and Club B red fields with highlighter race strokes; match rows below, hidden pairs under masking tape.
options.risk: Tape and marker turn to scrapbook costume if they leave the two jobs they own.

raised.raise: Club colour owns whole regions: each half of the totals band is its club's field, not a coloured dot.
Scale contrast does the ranking: totals are monumental, everything else lives at two small sizes.
State is a mark in a fixed cell: filled submitted, hollow not yet, never a loose coloured word.
Elevation means one thing: only a face-down card lifts off the sheet.
Figures carry the page: tabular numerals, no ornament around a number.

options.label: Lineup Card
options.lineage: the captain's paper lineup card and the director's score sheet
options.thesis: The paper the app replaces, made live: forms, ballpoint, a SUBMITTED stamp.
options.viewport: Totals as a filled form header; each match a ruled form row, stamped LIVE or FINAL.
options.risk: Familiar: paper-form renditions are where many runs land, and ruled rows drift toward ledger costume.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: Each round a coupon book; each match a coupon that stamps LIVE, then FINAL.
options.viewport: Navy header with carbon-numeral totals; match coupons stacked, face-down ones printed blank.
options.case: Fuses cleanly on clarity (match = coupon, stamps carry state); loses on audience, airline paper isn't the clubs' world.
options.risk: Reads like a travel app wearing a pickleball name.

options.label: Zoo Guide Map
options.thesis: Each club a swelling lobe of flat colour.
options.viewport: Two club lobes meeting at a coastline.
options.case: Loses both: lobes hide the scoreboard and nobody at the venue reads a garden map.

options.label: Crouwel Grid Specimen
options.thesis: Totals built cell by cell on a visible grid.
options.viewport: Monumental grid numerals for the club totals.
options.case: Loses both: the visible grid is poster costume on a working screen.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.lineage: pocket airline timetables on a light table
options.thesis: One type size; rank by weight, case and reversal.
options.case: Loses both: raked containers and one size fight the score race.
options.kept: State as a mark in a fixed cell.
options.risk: Rake reads as gimmick on phones.

options.label: Acetate Manual
options.thesis: Ply is the only rank; disabled is face-down.
options.case: Loses both: software manual is far from the court.

options.label: Variable Font Specimen
options.case: Loses both: no tie to the clubs, morphing type distracts.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean sports-scores app, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Scoreboard header with both totals, then match cards and ranking.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every scores app by design.
